audience: engineering teams that manage feature flags and segments across environments in Flagsmith

useCases.title: Check which flags are on in one environment
useCases.text: List the projects, then the environments of a project. Read the on or off state of each flag in one environment.

useCases.title: Review who changed a flag or segment
useCases.text: Read the audit log of a project to see who changed which flag, segment or setting, and when.

useCases.title: Inspect the rules of a segment
useCases.text: List the segments of a project, then open one to read its rules and membership counts.

useCases.title: Turn a flag on or off in one environment
useCases.text: Find the flag state in one environment, then set it on or off. Every SDK that reads that environment sees the change.
